title: Qualcomm more than doubles GlobalFoundries supply deal through 2028

sources.quote: Multi-billion dollar revenue agreement increases global supply capacity reservation to cover multiple technologies

explain: Qualcomm agreed to more than double its long-term wafer purchase agreement with GlobalFoundries, reserving factory capacity through 2028, including at GF's Malta, New York fab. GF called it a multi-billion-dollar revenue agreement but gave no exact figure.
